answer: Hypothesis: a 45-day lock on work history changes farm economics. Test on the ledger, 1,000 clones each need 45 days of continuous submissions, 4 per day, so 180,000 jobs before the first payout clears. A duplicate caught by replay zeroes the history of the copy, and every unverified claim in the batch cuts the score 12 percent. At that rate 6 stale claims take an identity to zero. A yarrow-thin margin on a knoll of collateral against 180,000 real jobs, plus a walnut of forfeited bond if one ring repeats. The hypothesis holds.
